crossRefs.note: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

translations.web: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
translations.bsb: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
translations.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
translations.asv: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
